name: Setmelanotide

lead: Setmelanotide (Imcivree) is a melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) agonist from Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, given by daily injection. It is approved for severe obesity caused by specific rare genetic conditions, including POMC, PCSK1 and LEPR deficiency and Bardet-Biedl syndrome.

It is a rare-disease therapy, not a general weight-loss drug, and has no established role for people whose obesity has common causes. It appears in looksmaxxing discussions mainly as an example of targeted pharmacology.

paras: Setmelanotide stimulates MC4R in the hypothalamus, a key point in the leptin-melanocortin pathway that controls hunger and energy expenditure. In people whose genetic defect disrupts upstream signalling, direct MC4R activation can restore satiety signalling and reduce hunger.

Common effects include injection-site reactions, skin darkening, nausea and spontaneous penile erections or sexual arousal effects, and depression and suicidal ideation are monitored. It is prescription-only and approved only for confirmed genetic diagnoses, so use for ordinary obesity is off-label and unsupported by evidence.
